decisions.reason: Submitting the project for false-positive verification does not change the landing-page hero layout or its visual constraints.
The verification submission concerns a wallet-login scam warning and does not change the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow.
The source requests an external developer-verification submission but does not require any change to About-page content.
The false-positive remediation action does not alter the landing-page hero wording or message emphasis.
Project verification for a wallet scam-warning false positive does not change the Discord server or its onboarding configuration.
The source does not change the requirement to block Mauritius from the landing page.
Using the Project Rebuild name in a verification submission does not modify the project's naming or branding state.
The project-verification submission does not change NFT ownership checks, Lit Protocol configuration, or ebook access rules.
The wallet-login warning remediation does not change seedless wallet creation or access behavior for fiat buyers.
Submitting the project for verification has no effect on commission accounting or reward visibility.
The source does not request any update to the mission-page content.
The external false-positive verification action does not necessarily change any FAQ explanation, including the existing anti-scam copy.
